A flowchart showing changes of state with circles representing particles. Top row: Solid (particles tightly packed in a square grid). Middle row: Liquid (particles touching but jumbled). Bottom row: Gas (particles widely separated with motion lines). Arrows indicate processes. Downward red arrows for heating: Solid to Liquid is "Melting", Liquid to Gas is "Boiling/Vapourization". Upward blue arrows for cooling: Gas to Liquid is "Condensation", Liquid to Solid is "Freezing".

Three side-by-side graphs for Boyle's law. Graph 1: Y-axis P, X-axis V. A smooth curve starting high on the y-axis and dropping down toward the x-axis. Graph 2: Y-axis P, X-axis 1/V. A straight line starting exactly from the origin (0,0) and going up diagonally. Graph 3: Y-axis PV, X-axis P. A flat horizontal line showing PV is constant.
